status: Character-story-v5 published; nine native chapter/balance tests, regional asset audits, paired scene review and two stdio quest replays passed. Later chapters use declared prior-access fixtures; no new uninterrupted Hall of Fame claim.
direction: Playable character conflict drives the journey. Found text is optional background and never the main-story completion action.

rival.name: REED
rival.motive: Wants status, wages and power over people. Treats care work as weakness. Deliberately joins Team ICE in front of a captive, knowing they kidnap people. Remains hostile and unrepentant.

arc.action: Brings a discarded egg case, dismisses its needs, challenges the player and leaves to seek paid backing.
Accepts a counterfeit badge and paid ICE post in front of Ellis.
Defends the holding-system controls after the player navigates the cargo/relay maze.
Oversees the drilling route with Lode, obstructs shutdown and fights the player again.
arc.status: native chapter verified in character-story-v5: live piston, Reed battle, shutdown, crew quest, return and Continue

arc.scene: Iron Range after the Boundary Waters shutdown
arc.action: LODE has stopped returning his calls. He blames the player and refuses gratitude; losing paid status does not redeem him.
arc.status: implemented source; not an earned full-campaign aftermath claim

tamarack.motive: Protect the field crew and nesting Pokémon displaced by drilling. Refuses to trade their safety for a contractor timetable. Personally tends the egg Reed discards.
quests: Take the original readings to IVY in Rochester because field instruments have stopped arriving.
Find the missing dispatcher and remove the stolen equipment from the ICE compound.
Investigate and stop the working drill operation with the field crew, then coordinate the harbor shutdown.

egg.behavior: Optional actual giveegg offer. Decline/full party allow retry; success alone sets the once-only flag. Continue preserves the egg. No PC fallback or mandatory hatch/capture gate.

lairs.purpose: Rescue Ellis and witness the diverted shipment and Reed joining ICE.
lairs.topology: Cargo-floor loop and upper relay maze, two distinct switches, blocked holding-system access, guarded alternative and earned short return.
events: A shipment moves while Ellis is held.
Player cuts holding-system power through the maze.
Reed fights for control; victory permits separate release.
Ellis walks out and gives the next destination in person.
lairs.evidence: Rescued witness and observed stolen instruments. The old dispatch paper cannot replace the lair or rescue.

lairs.purpose: Reach active drilling, recover stolen apparatus and stop a dangerous test.
lairs.topology: Branching mine approach, pump-gallery valve route and guarded core; real stairs, long approach before a shutdown shortcut, and no walking bypass of the objective.
events: Player sees and hears the drill operating.
Reed and foreman knowingly continue the test.
Player navigates the gallery and disables its feed.
Actual battles and separate apparatus recovery resolve the lair.
A field worker examines the apparatus with the player and directs the harbor expedition.
lairs.evidence: Observed drilling and recovered machinery. A found log cannot award the chapter.

acceptance: Rival appears early, visibly joins ICE and recurs with escalating choices and distinct parties.
Two substantial hand-authored maze-like lairs are connected and completed through production input.
Events, witnesses and physical actions grant progress; found text cannot substitute.
Tamarack/allies have personal motives, concrete quests and useful rewards.
Actual egg gift supports decline, full-party retry, once-only success and Continue.
Lair routes, gates, shortcuts, battles, losses, input ownership and persistence are verified.
Whole-map and matched native visual review pass; unrelated content and original audio are preserved.

pokemon_policy.scope: Every Pokemon appearing in the Minnesota story: starters, rival/villain/gym/League/route teams, gifts and eggs, wild encounters, trades, story pictures/cries and dialogue references.
pokemon_policy.rule: Only active Minnesota original species; no legacy species fallback. Historical packs and out-of-region source maps are not the playable Minnesota story.
pokemon_policy.audit_status: Character-story-v5 runtime-verified. The regional binder rejects foreign trainer, grant, encounter, actor, visible-text and cry appearances; current-policy preservation/legality tests pass. All nine native chapter/balance cases and both final-pack stdio quest replays pass.
